changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
• Live TV channel lists load even where an internet provider blocks them, no VPN needed
• 4K in Plex plays without dropping to 1080p
• Guide Favorites tip fixed
• Plus everything in 1.7.9: smooth Plex, Resume, Favorites in the Guide, volume to 150%
releaseNotes: Version 1.8.0: Live TV channel lists now load even on internet providers that block them, so no VPN is needed. 4K movies in Plex wait for a proper head start and play without dropping to 1080p. Includes everything in 1.7.9: smooth Plex playback and Resume, Favorites in the TV Guide, volume up to 150% and Playback stats.
